chunks: And Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام said:
“You say at the end of every salat (prayer): O Allah, guide me from Your presence, and pour upon me from Your bounty, and spread over me from Your mercy, and send down upon me from Your blessings.”

key_terms.اللَّهُمَّ: O Allah, a direct form of supplication

ai.seo_question: What supplication should be said after every salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a concise supplication to be recited after every salat (prayer). It asks Allah for guidance, bounty, mercy, and blessings, showing the spiritual importance of ta'qib after prayer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.951 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:

"Say after every prayer:
Allahumma ihdini min ‘indika, wa afid ‘alayya min fadlika, wa unshur ‘alayya min rahmatika, wa anzil ‘alayya min barakatika
‘O’ Allah (swt), guide me from Your side, and bestow upon me from Your bounty, and spread over me from Your mercy, and send down upon me from Your blessings.’"
